worlds.title: The Hundred-Year Silence
worlds.author: HeroicSandal
worlds.description: For a hundred years the Rite of Giving was performed and nothing came. This year it worked — and the Church is owed a debt for every year it waited.

worlds.title: The Girl Everyone Fears
worlds.author: HeroicSandal
worlds.genre: College drama — social hierarchy, rivalry, romance
worlds.description: You run this campus. Then your mother introduces a fiancé and his son, and for the first time in years someone looks at you like you are not frightening at all.
